notes.title: Game is released!
notes.content:
Greetings, Survivors!

We're thrilled to announce that the long-awaited moment has arrived [b]"Disaster Island"[/b] is now officially released on Steam! Immerse yourself in the ultimate survival experience as you navigate the challenges of an unforgiving island teeming with danger and mystery. The game has undergone many bug fixes and gameplay improvements.

Share your survival stories, screenshots, and tips with the community. We want to hear about your adventures on Disaster Island!

I wish everyone a happy and relaxing holiday season and especially that you find lots of crates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42207759/0a73087e240e7e1a4923ee88f08d382728a37535.png[/img]

notes.title: Release 0.2 | Guides
notes.content:
Welcome back, we've got some news for you!
[h2]News[/h2]
[list]
[*]Guide
[*]Small hint bar
[*]Redesigned helipads for more PVP
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Heliport locations are redesigned to suit more for combat
[*]Changes meteorite spawning
[*]Gain more experience in the survival mode
[*]Increased difficulty in harder difficulties
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Time slowdown after pressing some buttons
[*]Not winning game, after somebody dies at helipad
[*]Fixed airstrike delay after alarm
[*]Invisibility when standing on smokegrande
[*]Several grammatical errors corrected
[*]Bug with the camera at the end of the game
[*]And more…..
[/list]

If you experience any issues or want to give feedback, please feel free to post on the steam community.
Thanks.

notes.title: Finally, this Friday.
notes.content:
This [b]Friday[/b], you'll finally get a chance to play the game in early access. You can play up to three game modes. One singleplayer and two multiplayer. So don't hesitate and try to survive on this deadly island.

Disaster Island is still under heavy development so we would love to hear your feedback and suggestions as we move towards its full release, and if you want to participate in the development don't forget to follow our [b]TikTok[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42207759/1d70b6e5422a4e2f25d25cbba2bd64781ba06b19.png[/img]

notes.title: The game is now in closed beta
notes.content:
Hello, 
The game is now ready for beta testing and bug fixing. A lot of new things have been added to the game, including cosmetic stuff. Unfortunately some things have to be pushed back to later updates until they are fully ready for release.

When Early Access is released, you can look forward to this gamemodes :
- Survival mode
- Last man standing
- Flashflood

I'll be glad for any feedback and comments.

Developer
